newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss building permit requests up 2.2 pct in H1 97.
newsitem.headline: Swiss building permit requests up 2.2 pct in H1 97.

text.p: Swiss applications for building permits rose 2.2 percent in the first half of 1997 from the year-earlier period to 12,673, a survey by the Swiss Construction Information Centre found.
The June index (June 1989 = 100) stood at 80.80 point. The May index had stood at 79.34.

Applications for large-scale renovations rose 2.8 percent in the period, while those for new buildings rose 1.8 percent. Applications for housing projects were up 3.5 percent from a year earlier, while public-sector projects rose 18.6 percent, it said in a statement.
